name: Phu Quoc
provinceNote: Phú Quốc is a special zone of An Giang. Nghị quyết 1654, passed 16 June 2025, joined Dương Đông, An Thới, and the old communes into đặc khu Phú Quốc. The new commune-level governments operate from 1 July 2025. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam and Vườn quốc gia Phú Quốc still place the island in Kiên Giang.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: An island in the Gulf of Thailand with a long west-coast beach. Watch sunset on Bãi Trường, swim at Bãi Sao, ride to Hòn Thơm, and eat at the Dương Đông night market, with pepper gardens and pearl stalls.
timeNeeded: A day on the west coast, longer with Bãi Sao
fee: No single island ticket. Bãi Sao entrance and parking are free on the 3-day account. Other beach admission is Check on arrival.
getThere: 1 hour by air from Ho Chi Minh City
bestMonths: November–April, and lunar month 11 to lunar month 4
seoTitle: Phu Quoc travel guide — Bai Truong, Sao Beach, Hon Thom, the night market
seoDescription: Sunset on Bãi Trường, a swim at Bãi Sao, the Hòn Thơm cable car, and the Dương Đông night market. Pepper gardens and pearl stalls are on the island. The flight from Ho Chi Minh City is 1 hour.
intro: You come for sunset on Bãi Trường, a swim at Bãi Sao, the Hòn Thơm cable car, and the Dương Đông night market, with pepper gardens inland and pearl stalls in town. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam places Bãi Trường on the southwest, about 20 km from Mũi Dinh Cậu to Khóe Tàu Rũ, a gently sloping yellow sand with water clear enough to see the seaweed. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism puts the swimming, the food, the cocktails, the live music, the DJs, and the fire shows on this west coast, and calls it a place to watch the sun set over the ocean. It does not name a colour for Long Beach. The day in front of you is the surf, the sand, the palms, and the low buildings on the shore.

Bãi Sao is the other swim, not the sunset. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the sand is cát vàng óng, about 25 minutes by road from the centre of Dương Đông, with calm water, shade trees, Robinson huts, and a boat 15–30 km offshore for squid. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism calls it powder-white on one account and white on another, with coconut palms, green hills, and the island’s sunrise, and says to come early on a weekday. The 3-day account says entrance and parking are free. Jet skis, a water park, and parasailing are named there.

In Dương Đông, Dinh Cậu stands on the rocks at the north end of the long beach. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the temple was built in 1937 for Cậu, a deity over the waters, to protect boats in heavy weather. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism also calls it Dinh Cau Temple and Dinh Cau Pagoda, and says sailors pray to the goddess of the sea. The day account says the lighthouse doubles as a shrine to the Goddess of the Sea. After the beach empties, the squid boats light the water. Dinner in town is the night market. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names the Phu Quoc Night Market, where you choose the catch and have it grilled, with fruit and snacks. The 3-day account puts that market on Bạch Đằng in Dương Đông, pedestrian in the evening, with 50-plus stalls. The nature account says Dương Đông seafood market. The pearl account says chợ đêm Dinh Cậu. The night account says the streets near Dinh Cậu are closed to traffic from 5 pm until midnight, with 100-odd stalls. The day account says more than a hundred vendors. The three names were not shown to be one gate.

Bún quây is the morning bowl: rice-flour noodles with fish, shrimp, squid, herbs, and onion, and a sauce you mix from chili, sugar, fish sauce, and citrus. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says it arrived from central Vietnam in 1955 as ground shrimp, was called bún tôm until 1996, and is now served through the day and into the evening. Eat it on the street across from the Dương Đông harbour, or along Long Beach. The barrel houses are the fish sauce. Hội nước mắm Phú Quốc describes a dark cockroach-wing colour, salty and deeply sweet, nitrogen 20–43 gN/lít, and the introduction there says up to 40°N. The salt ratio is 2.5–3 fish to 1 salt, aged 12 months, from the Gulf of Thailand, Kiên Giang and Cà Mau waters. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the first draw is about a year, one workshop ages cá cơm than for 15 months to 43 percent, the salt ratio is 3 tons of fish to 1 ton of salt, and output is over 10 million litres a year. The district account says about 6 million litres a year and nitrogen trên 25ºC. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s fish-sauce account says the clear Andaman Sea. Pepper is the inland morning: aromatic and spicy on the nature account, a floral aroma and intense heat on the whisper account, and pungent and spicy, over 1,000 tons a year, on the 3-day account.

Give the south its own day. Nhà tù Phú Quốc, also called trại giam Cây Dừa, is in An Thới, about 30 km southeast of Dương Đông. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam ranks it a national historic relic in 1996 and a special national relic in March 2015. The Hòn Thơm cable car leaves from Bãi Đất Đỏ, about 31 km from Dương Đông and about 21 km from the airport. Sun World Hon Thom says the system is 7,899.9 m and the ride is 15 minutes, and also about 13 km. From 1 January 2026 the return ticket is 850,000 đồng above 1.4 m and 700,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m, free under 1 m, with runs at 09:30–11:30, 13:30–14:00, and 15:30–17:30. The earlier Sun World account, applied from 9 December 2023, says 650,000 đồng for an adult and 500,000 đồng for a child, free under 1 m, and hours 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00. Weather and maintenance can change them. Kiss of the Sea and Cầu Hôn sit outside the ticket.

The national park is the northeast half-day. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism calls a short version a half-day trek or a motorbike ride. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam describes a 4-hour tour to Núi Chúa, 565 m, on the Hàm Ninh range. UNESCO lists the Kien Giang Biosphere Reserve, nominated in 2006, not a World Heritage inscription. Cục Bảo tồn thiên nhiên và Đa dạng sinh học dates that recognition 27 October 2006. The reserve point, latitude 9.96 and longitude 104.53, is not Dương Đông.
gettingAround: Phu Quoc International Airport is in Duong To. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names direct flights from Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and abroad. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says Vietnam Airlines flies Hồ Chí Minh City–Phú Quốc in 1 hour and Rạch Giá–Phú Quốc in 40 minutes. Sun Group has operated the airport since 1 January 2026. The contact address is Duong To quarter, Phu Quoc SEZ, An Giang. On the island, Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names motorbike rental, local taxi, minibus, and coaches. Hàm Ninh is 20 km northeast of Dương Đông. The park approach is the Dương Đông–Hàm Ninh road, then about 10 km north. The main island is 573 km², 50 km long, and widest in the north at 25 km, one of 36 islands. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism calls Phú Quốc the country’s largest island. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam calls the old island district the largest island district in Vietnam.

Superdong’s fast boat from Rạch Giá is 2 giờ 35 phút on the district account. The operator lists clocks and no crossing minutes: Rạch Giá to Phú Quốc at 7:00, 8:10, 10:30, and 13:10, and back at 7:10, 10:10, 13:00, and 14:00, boats III, IV, V, and X, capacity given as 306 and 275 passengers, 26–28 hải lý/giờ. Hà Tiên to Phú Quốc leaves at 6:15, 7:30, 8:00, and 13:45, and back at 8:00, 8:20, 9:45, and 13:00, boats VI, VII, VIII, and IX, 275 passengers. Clocks can change with tide and weather. Dương Đông is 120 km from Rạch Giá and 45 km from Hà Tiên. Those are distances, not boat times. Nam Du leaves Phú Quốc at 8:00 and returns at 14:00, boat VI. The island office is 187 Nguyễn Trung Trực, khu phố 5, đặc khu Phú Quốc. Ticket counters are listed twice: Rạch Giá at 14 Tự Do, Phường Vĩnh Thanh, and also at Số 01 Lô 4 Đường 3/2, Phường Rạch Giá, Tỉnh An Giang; Hà Tiên at 11 Trần Hầu, Phường Bình San, and also at Số 11 Đường Trần Hầu, Phường Hà Tiên, Tỉnh An Giang.

stayAreas.name: Long Beach
stayAreas.summary: Sleep on this west-coast sand if the sunset and the evening are the trip. Dinner and cocktails run along the shore. The north is the other bed: the park foothills keep high-rise rooms off Gành Dầu.

eat: Bún quây is the morning bowl, on the harbour street in Dương Đông and along Long Beach. Dinner is the catch you point at in the Dương Đông night market, or a table along Bãi Trường. Hàm Ninh’s plate is boiled crab with muối tiêu chanh. Bãi Thơm stops for a coconut, a hotpot, or a seafood platter.
interestsBody: Sunset is Bãi Trường: the surf, the palms, and the evening along the shore. Bãi Sao is the southeast swim. Hòn Thơm is the south-day cable car.
Dinner is the Dương Đông night market. Pepper gardens and pearl stalls are the island’s own goods.

cards.title: Dining and F&B

interestGroups.summary: The Dương Đông night market after 5 pm, pepper gardens inland, and pearl stalls in town.
body: Pearl stalls sit in Dương Đông, at chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, at cảng An Thới, and at cảng Bãi Vòng.

cards.title: Night market
cards.summary: Choose the catch and have it grilled. The night account closes the streets near Dinh Cậu from 5 pm until midnight.

cards.title: Pepper gardens
cards.summary: Inland gardens: aromatic and spicy, a floral heat on one account, and over 1,000 tons a year on the 3-day account.

interestGroups.title: West-coast sand
interestGroups.summary: Bãi Trường is the shore the night is for. The sunset, the music, and the bed are on this sand.
body: Sleep on Long Beach when the sunset and the evening are why you came. The north, at Gành Dầu, is the bed the park foothills keep clear of high-rise rooms.

blocks.heading: The west-coast shore
paragraphs: Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam calls Bãi Trường yellow sand, gently sloping, about 20 km from Mũi Dinh Cậu to Khóe Tàu Rũ, with clear green water. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism does not name a colour. It places swimming, food, cocktails, live music, DJs, and fire shows on this west coast, and the sunset over the ocean. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam also names sunrise.
No beach ticket is given. A future eco-tourism project, Thuận An, on the north of Bãi Trường in xã Dương Tơ, is described as allowed. It is not an open hotel.

blocks.heading: Dương Đông after the swim
paragraphs: Dinh Cậu was built in 1937 for Cậu, on the Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam account. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says sailors pray to the goddess of the sea, and also writes Dinh Cau Temple and Dinh Cau Pagoda. The visit is the sunset, then the squid-boat lights.

The night market is named three ways: Phu Quoc Night Market on Bạch Đằng, with 50-plus stalls and no clock; Dương Đông seafood market, with no street; and chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, where the streets near the temple are closed to traffic from 5 pm until midnight and the night account counts 100-odd stalls. The day account says more than a hundred vendors. You choose the catch and have it grilled. Bún quây is the morning bowl on the harbour street and on Long Beach. Bún kèn is a noodle with a broth of dried fish, coconut milk, and a dash of curry powder.

About 6 million litres a year and nitrogen trên 25ºC on the district account. Over 10 million litres a year, and one workshop at 43 percent after 15 months, on the tourism account. Hội nước mắm Phú Quốc gives 20–43 gN/lít and up to 40°N, salt at 2.5–3 fish to 1 salt, and 12 months. The tourism account uses 3 tons of fish to 1 ton of salt and about one year. The association says the Gulf of Thailand. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says the clear Andaman Sea. Pepper gardens are the inland half of the same morning. Pearl stalls sit in Dương Đông, at chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, at cảng An Thới, and at cảng Bãi Vòng. Shop names are not the visit.

blocks.heading: The quiet north
paragraphs: Gành Dầu is the morning when you want the crowds behind you. The park foothills keep high-rise rooms off that beach. The nature account names a flat hike under old trees and a coral garden for snorkelling. The 45 km figure is the distance to Hà Tiên, not to Gành Dầu.

Bãi Thơm is the northern tip, still little developed, with a view toward Cambodia. A stop there is a coconut, a hotpot, or a seafood platter. The island-hopping account puts the floating restaurants on Rạch Vẹm Beach, the village next to Starfish Beach. The 3-day account puts starfish beach in Rạch Vẹm fishing village, about 20 km north of Dương Đông, and says the catch is cooked on the spot. The accounts say starfish are in the shallows. They do not name a season. Bioluminescent plankton is described at Starfish Beach, on the south of Long Beach, and on the north of Dat Do Beach, at the right times of year, with no months.

Vinpearl Safari Phú Quốc is the animal park in xã Gành Dầu, not a place to sleep. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says it is open 09:00–16:00 every day. Under 1 m is free. From 1 m to 1.4 m, and visitors over 60, pay 400,000 đồng. Over 1.4 m pays 500,000 đồng.

A short park visit is a half-day trek or a motorbike ride, and a longer one is the 4-hour tour to Núi Chúa, 565 m, on the Hàm Ninh range. Hàm Ninh, 20 km northeast, has a 300 m mountain behind the village. Núi Chúa is a different summit on the same range. The village plate is ghẹ luộc with muối tiêu chanh. Coral counts: 89 hard, 19 soft, and 62 seaweed on the district account; nearly 100 hard, nearly 20 soft, and 62 seaweed on the tourism and NBCA park accounts. UNESCO’s counts for the whole reserve are 89 hard, 19 soft, 125 reef fishes, 132 molluscs, 32 echinoderms, and 62 seaweed. The NBCA biosphere account says 87 coral species and 10 seagrass species.

blocks.heading: An Thới and the cable
paragraphs: The prison walk is the fist monument, a cemetery, indoor and outdoor displays, a documentary, and models of the punishments. The history Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam gives: a French camp, Cây Dừa, in 1950; after July 1954 the camp stopped; in 1966 it expanded to 400 cells; by 1972 it had 14 zones; from 1967 to 1973 it held more than 40,000 prisoners, of whom more than 4,000 died; 42 escapes were organised.

Sun World Hon Thom lists two return tariffs: 850,000 đồng and 700,000 đồng from 1 January 2026, and 650,000 đồng and 500,000 đồng on the account applied from 9 December 2023. Under 1 m is free on both. The 2026 runs are 09:30–11:30, 13:30–14:00, and 15:30–17:30. The 2023 hours are 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00. The length is 7,899.9 m and 15 minutes, and also about 13 km. The ticket includes one same-day entry to Sun World Hon Thom, Làng Exotica, and Aquatopia. It does not include food, lodging, diving, walking under the sea, or the Sunset Town extras. A south-island boat to Fingernail Island is a swim and a snorkel.

cards.title: Long Beach
cards.summary: The west-coast sand: surf, palms, and the low buildings on the shore.

interestGroups.title: Southeast swim
interestGroups.summary: Bãi Sao is the morning swim at the other end of the island. Sunset stays on Long Beach.

cards.title: Sao Beach
cards.summary: Pale sand, calm water, and a forested hill, about 25 minutes from Dương Đông.

blocks.heading: Bãi Sao
paragraphs: Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says cát vàng óng, fine like a carpet, calm clear water, and green shade trees, about 25 minutes from the centre of Dương Đông. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says powder-white sand and calm turquoise water, and also white sand, coconut palms, and green hills. Come early on a weekday. The island’s sunrise is this beach. The sunset beach is Long Beach.

Robinson huts and hammocks are on the sand, and a boat goes 15–30 km offshore to fish for squid and eat the catch on the boat. The snacks here are cùi biên mai nướng and rượu sim rừng. Jet skis, a water park, and parasailing are on offer. The 3-day account says entrance and parking are free. Western and Vietnamese food is served along the beach.

faqs.q: Where should I sleep on Phu Quoc?
faqs.a: On Long Beach if the sunset and the evening are the trip. Dinner and cocktails run along that sand. Choose Gành Dầu if you want the park foothills between the beach and high-rise rooms.

faqs.q: How do I get to Phu Quoc?
faqs.a: Vietnam Airlines flies Hồ Chí Minh City–Phú Quốc in 1 hour, and Rạch Giá–Phú Quốc in 40 minutes, on the Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam account. Hanoi and flights from abroad are named without a duration. Superdong’s Rạch Giá boat is 2 giờ 35 phút on that same account. The operator lists clocks for Rạch Giá and Hà Tiên.
Bún quây, traditionally a morning bowl and now served through the day. Eat it on the street across from the Dương Đông harbour, or along Long Beach.

faqs.q: What does the Hòn Thơm cable car cost?
faqs.a: From 1 January 2026 the return is 850,000 đồng above 1.4 m and 700,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m. From 9 December 2023 the account lists 650,000 đồng for an adult and 500,000 đồng for a child. Under 1 m is free on both. The 2026 runs are 09:30–11:30, 13:30–14:00, and 15:30–17:30. The 2023 hours are 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00. Weather can change them.

season.label: Calm seas, Nov–Apr
season.note: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism calls November to April the dry season, with calm seas and clear skies, and May to October the rainy season, with rougher seas and short heavy showers. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam counts the dry season from lunar month 11 to lunar month 4, and the rainy season from lunar month 5 to lunar month 10. Superdong says the boat clocks can change with tide and weather.
